name: browser-use
headline: Researching Web - Automated Web Research
short_description: Automates web research, generates HTML reports with confidence scores, contradiction detection, and source attribution. Benefits operations teams by streamlining data gathering and analysis. Integrates with Claude Code for automated research tasks.
author: vasilievyakov

sections.overview:
Researching Web transforms any question into a comprehensive research report by combining semantic search with parallel content extraction. The skill synthesizes 5+ sources simultaneously, detects contradictions between conflicting information, and generates beautiful HTML reports with transparency. Each finding includes a confidence score broken down by consensus level, source authority, and content freshness. Unlike traditional AI responses, every claim is attributed to specific sources with scoring methodology visible. The skill auto-selects optimal search depth based on query classification and outputs publication-ready reports with dark/light theme support.
Market research and competitive analysis with multi-source synthesis
Fact-checking and contradiction detection across industry sources
Due diligence reports with transparent source scoring and attribution
Technical comparison analysis (frameworks, tools, platforms)
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/vasilievyakov/researching-web-skill`
sections.usage:
```
I need you to research [TOPIC] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use the Researching Web skill to gather information, generate an HTML report with confidence scores, detect contradictions, and attribute sources. Focus on [SPECIFIC DATA POINTS] and provide insights relevant to [COMPANY]'s goals.
```
Copy

```
# Research Report on Sustainable Packaging Trends for GreenPack Solutions
```
